teaser: Four gates, four boarding calls, and only the last one gets you moving — you are a life path 5, the Adventurer, crossed with an ENTP, the Debater, and you would rather miss a flight than sit still waiting for it. The 5 asks for motion as a way of living; the ENTP asks for a question worth chasing. Cross them and you get someone who treats a closed door as an invitation, who can talk a stranger into a new plan before the coffee cools. The particular risk is not boredom. It is having so many doors open that none of them gets walked through twice.
excerpt: The lobby sign out front buzzes and dies and buzzes again, and you notice it the way you notice everything, mid-sentence, mid-charm, already halfway toward the next topic before the first one lands with whoever is…
